question: The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Bill, 2024, proposes a minimum fine of _____ for those involved in organised crimes of cheating.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1 Crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Bill, 2024, is a legislative proposal aimed at curbing organized cheating in public examinations.
 
• It proposes a stringent penalty structure to deter individuals and groups from engaging in cheating activities.
 
• The bill stipulates a minimum fine of ₹1 Crore for those found guilty of organized cheating.
 
• This significant penalty highlights the government's commitment to maintaining the integrity and fairness of public examinations.
 
• The legislation is part of broader efforts to enhance the quality and credibility of the education system in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Organized Cheating:**

 
 
• Involves systematic and planned efforts to manipulate examination processes to unfairly benefit certain individuals.
 
• Methods can include impersonation, use of unauthorized electronic devices, and collusion with examination officials.
 
 
 
• **Public Examinations:**
 
 
• Assessments conducted by government or authorized bodies to evaluate the knowledge and skills of candidates.
 
• Examples include board exams, entrance tests for higher education, and recruitment exams for government jobs.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Measures:**
 
 
• Legislation is a key tool used by governments to enforce rules and maintain order within various sectors, including education.
 
• Effective legislation can help deter malpractice and ensure fair conduct in public services.
 
 
 
• **Education Integrity:**
 
 
• Maintaining the credibility and fairness of the education system is crucial for ensuring equal opportunities for all students.
 
• Integrity in education fosters trust among stakeholders, including students, parents, educators, and employers.
